label: Flash DAPLink
command: openocd -f interface/cmsis-dap.cfg -c "transport select swd; adapter speed 1000" -c "set CHIPNAME gd32f470; source [find target/stm32f4x.cfg]" -c "program build/debug/gd32f470_template.elf verify reset exit"

label: Build + Flash
command: sh -c 'cmake --build --preset debug && openocd -f interface/cmsis-dap.cfg -c "transport select swd; adapter speed 1000" -c "set CHIPNAME gd32f470; source [find target/stm32f4x.cfg]" -c "program build/debug/gd32f470_template.elf verify reset exit"'

label: Switch Modbus + Flash
command: sh -c 'sed -i "s/ACTIVE_PROTOCOL  PROTOCOL_STRING_CMD/ACTIVE_PROTOCOL  PROTOCOL_MODBUS/" App/inc/protocol.hpp; touch App/src/protocol.cpp App/src/protocol_string.cpp user/src/founction.cpp; cmake --build --preset debug && openocd -f interface/cmsis-dap.cfg -c "transport select swd; adapter speed 1000" -c "set CHIPNAME gd32f470; source [find target/stm32f4x.cfg]" -c "program build/debug/gd32f470_template.elf verify reset exit"'

label: Switch String + Flash
command: sh -c 'sed -i "s/ACTIVE_PROTOCOL  PROTOCOL_MODBUS/ACTIVE_PROTOCOL  PROTOCOL_STRING_CMD/" App/inc/protocol.hpp; touch App/src/protocol.cpp App/src/protocol_string.cpp user/src/founction.cpp; cmake --build --preset debug && openocd -f interface/cmsis-dap.cfg -c "transport select swd; adapter speed 1000" -c "set CHIPNAME gd32f470; source [find target/stm32f4x.cfg]" -c "program build/debug/gd32f470_template.elf verify reset exit"'
